I was arrested at 20 years old for evasion of arrest in a vehicle, assault of a public servant, and something like "resisting a search".Whatever it was, it amounted to two felonies and a misdemeanor.

===

1733344017486909920 [2023-12-09] @BLUNDERBUSSTED 💜 85
They eventually handed out salami sandwiches. Literally two slices of wonderbread with one pitiful slice of salami between them. I was too hung over. The homeless man asked for mine. I gave it to him. He chuckled.
↓
1733344266645373214 [2023-12-09] @BLUNDERBUSSTED 💜 89
He then went into the toilet stall located right behind us Suicidal Folk, went in with the sandwiches, and I heard his laughter and muttering increase in volume.He exited. Sat next to me. Chuckled. Then retrieved part of a sandwich from his pants.He'd put them in his pants.
↓
1733344466172547308 [2023-12-09] @BLUNDERBUSSTED 💜 93 🔁 1
Anyway, we were seated in this room waiting to be arraigned.I talked to a female cop at the front who was actually kind to me, first kind person I'd met since this thing began, and asked about the jail. She told me kinda where I did and didn't want to be, that there's a library
↓
1733344657772572979 [2023-12-09] @BLUNDERBUSSTED 💜 108
Her shift ended, and I sat there just waiting. Waiting. Waiting forever.Waiting is its own kind of torture. There's a pain to just sitting and doing nothing that's profound, especially when you're waiting for charges you're unaware of which will maybe probably destroy ur life.
↓
1733344871900176556 [2023-12-09] @BLUNDERBUSSTED 💜 102
Eventually I get called up along with a batch of fuckers after waiting no less than literally 12 hours.We wait outside a little courtroom thing. People are talking about what they did. No one's guilty. Not even the guy who beat the shit out of his wife. No one.
↓
1733345177203593657 [2023-12-09] @BLUNDERBUSSTED 💜 92 🔁 1
I'm not guilty. I got drugged. Lol.Anyway, we file into this little courtroom. There's a judge. He reads our charges. Assault. Battery. Theft. Prostitution. Etc. Great.We get to mine. I'd not heard mine yet. I grimace. He reads.
↓
1733345453058764994 [2023-12-09] @BLUNDERBUSSTED 💜 126
Felony evasion of arrest in a vehicleFelony assault of a public servantMisdemeanor resist of searchI about shit myself, but I also, swear to you, got a sense of satisfaction in seeing a kind of respect rise in the other jail occupants' eyes.
